lines.text: You'd never lose a week of mornings to one word.
These two did.
Arjun drives to the tech park. Kabir, his new neighbour, works there too. No car.
So Arjun texts him. Pick you up at the gate, eight sharp.
Monday. Arjun waits at the gate. Kabir waits at the gate. Nobody comes.
Tuesday. Twenty minutes each. Still nobody.
Wednesday, they both text, I am literally at the gate.
And they were both telling the truth.
This colony has two gates.
Front gate. Back gate. Two hundred metres apart.
The guard? He figured it out on Monday.
Nobody asked him.
Thursday, both of them walk over to the other gate.
Different paths. Perfect swap.
Lesson: the gate is not a place.
So the pickup moved into an app.
Kabir taps, I'm at the pickup point. One spot.
And Arjun's car crawls closer on the map.
Friday. One car. One gate. Zero waiting.
And the guard? Now they ask him first.
Their pickup point? Neither gate. The chai stall in the middle.
If meet me at the gate ruined your morning, try Sahyatri.
Link in bio.
